english.title: Use on a road a motor vehicle without an indication in the cab that the overall travelling height exceeds 3 metres
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), the overall travelling height of which exceeded 3 metres, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACTUAL HEIGHT..), and failed to display in the cab of the vehicle in such a manner that it could be easily read by the driver a notice which met the requirements of regulation 10(3) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 10(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
